summary: Sampler that plays the song's waves (wavetable slots, from wave_import) and built-in samples: 16 zones by key and velocity range, each with its wave, root, tune, level, pan, start, end, loop with crossfade, gate or one-shot, reverse and a choke group; a wave slot's layers split its keys by root or alternate round robin; amp and filter envelopes, velocity to level and filter, pitch bend; Kit mode puts zone n on key Kit base + n − 1 as a one-shot drum. Use it for drum kits, sampled instruments and one-shots.
use_for: Play the song's waves across the keyboard with key zones, loops and filters.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Instrument: each zone plays the notes in its key and velocity ranges, tuned from its root; Kit: zone n plays key Kit base + n − 1 at its own pitch, one-shot (key and velocity ranges, root, loop and trigger aside)
parameters.how: Chooses Instrument (zones play by key and velocity range, tuned from their root) or Kit (each zone gets its own key, one-shot).
parameters.sound: Instrument mode plays a sample as a melodic instrument, and Kit mode turns zones into a drum pad set.

parameters.name: Kit base
parameters.description: The key zone 1 plays in Kit mode (36 = C2, General MIDI's kick: zone 3 is D2 the snare, 7 F#2 the closed hat, 11 A#2 the open hat); the others follow a semitone apart
parameters.how: Sets the key that plays zone 1 in Kit mode, from 0 to 112; the other zones follow a semitone apart.
parameters.sound: Move it to line the kit up with the keys or pads you play it from.

parameters.name: Polyphony
parameters.description: Voices that sound at once (each zone a note plays takes one); past it a new voice takes the quietest released one, else the oldest, fading it out in 3 ms
parameters.how: Sets how many voices can sound at once, from 1 to 32.
parameters.sound: More voices let long samples and chords overlap, and fewer make new notes cut off the quietest older ones.

parameters.name: Bend range
parameters.description: Pitch bend range
parameters.how: Sets how far the pitch bend wheel moves the pitch, from 0 to 24 semitones.
parameters.sound: A small range gives expressive nudges, and a large one gives big sweeps.

parameters.name: Vel → amp
parameters.description: How much velocity sets the level: the gain is velocity^(2 × this) (100 %: velocity 64 is −12 dB; 0 %: every note at full level)
parameters.how: Sets how strongly note velocity changes the loudness, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: High values make dynamics audible, and 0 % makes all notes equally loud.

parameters.name: Vel crossfade
parameters.description: Zones whose velocity ranges meet crossfade (equal power) over this many velocity steps around the boundary instead of switching; 0 switches
parameters.how: Sets how many velocity steps zones crossfade over where their velocity ranges meet, from 0 to 64.
parameters.sound: Zero switches abruptly between layers, and higher values blend them smoothly as you play harder.

parameters.name: Volume
parameters.description: Output level
parameters.how: Sets the output level of the sampler, from -60 to +12 dB, or off.
parameters.sound: Use it to place the instrument in the mix without changing its tone.

parameters.name: Amp attack
parameters.description: Attack time (the shortest, 0.5 ms, keeps a note starting mid-wave from clicking)
parameters.how: Sets how long the loudness envelope takes to rise at the start of a note, from 0.5 ms to 20 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short attacks keep the sample's own start, and long ones fade it in slowly like a pad.

parameters.name: Amp decay
parameters.description: Decay time (to −60 dB of the way to sustain)
parameters.how: Sets how long the loudness envelope takes to fall to its sustain level, from 0.5 ms to 20 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short decays make a plucky note, and long ones let it ring down slowly.

parameters.name: Amp sustain
parameters.description: Sustain level
parameters.how: Sets the loudness the note holds while the key stays down, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: A low sustain makes the note die away even when held, and 100 % keeps it at full volume.

parameters.name: Amp release
parameters.description: Release time after the note ends (to −60 dB)
parameters.how: Sets how long the note takes to fade out after the key is released, from 0.5 ms to 20 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short releases stop the note cleanly, and long ones let it fade out after you let go.

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: Filter on every voice: off, ladder low-pass 24 or 12 dB/oct, state-variable band-pass or high-pass
parameters.how: Chooses the filter on every voice: off, a 24 or 12 dB low-pass, band-pass or high-pass.
parameters.sound: The low-pass darkens the sample, the band-pass makes it thin and nasal, and the high-pass removes its body.

parameters.name: Cutoff
parameters.description: Sets the filter cutoff frequency, from 20 Hz to 20 kHz.
parameters.how: Sets the filter cutoff frequency, from 20 Hz to 20 kHz.
parameters.sound: Low values make the sound dark and muffled, and high values open it up.

parameters.name: Resonance
parameters.description: Resonance (the ladder self-oscillates at the top)
parameters.how: Sets the filter resonance, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: More resonance puts a whistling peak at the cutoff, and the top turns it into a ringing tone.

parameters.name: Filter env
parameters.description: Filter envelope amount (±6 octaves)
parameters.how: Sets how much the filter envelope moves the cutoff, up to six octaves either way.
parameters.sound: Positive amounts make each note open and close, and negative ones sweep the other way.

parameters.name: Key track
parameters.description: Cutoff follows the keyboard around C4 (100 %: an octave per octave)
parameters.how: Sets how much the cutoff follows the note pitch, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: At 100 % the brightness stays even over the keyboard, and lower values make high notes duller.

parameters.name: Filter vel
parameters.description: Softer notes close the filter (up to 3 octaves at the lowest velocity)
parameters.how: Sets how much soft notes close the filter, up to three octaves.
parameters.sound: Harder playing sounds brighter, which makes the instrument feel more expressive.

parameters.name: Flt attack
parameters.description: Attack time
parameters.how: Sets how long the filter envelope takes to rise, from 0.5 ms to 20 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short attacks open the filter at once, and long ones make the brightness swell in.

parameters.name: Flt decay
parameters.description: Decay time
parameters.how: Sets how long the filter envelope takes to fall to its sustain level, from 0.5 ms to 20 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short decays make a quick wah-like snap, and long ones a slow sweep down.

parameters.name: Flt sustain
parameters.description: Sustain level
parameters.how: Sets the level the filter envelope holds while the key stays down, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: A high sustain keeps the filter open while a key is held, and a low one lets it close.

parameters.name: Flt release
parameters.description: Release time
parameters.how: Sets how long the filter envelope takes to fall back after the key is released, from 0.5 ms to 20 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short releases close the filter at once, and long ones let the tone fade out.

parameters.name: Z1 wave
parameters.description: Zone 1's wave: 0 off, 1–200 a slot of the song's wavetable (wave_import), 201 on a built-in sample (the manual lists them)
parameters.how: Chooses the sound zone 1 plays: off, a wave slot of the song, or a built-in sample.
parameters.sound: The wave is the raw material of the zone; each slot or sample has its own character.

parameters.name: Z1 key low
parameters.description: Zone 1: the lowest key it plays (Instrument mode)
parameters.how: Sets the lowest key zone 1 plays in Instrument mode.
parameters.sound: Together with the high key it decides which part of the keyboard triggers this zone.

parameters.name: Z1 key high
parameters.description: Zone 1: the highest key it plays (Instrument mode)
parameters.how: Sets the highest key zone 1 plays in Instrument mode.
parameters.sound: Together with the low key it decides which part of the keyboard triggers this zone.

parameters.name: Z1 vel low
parameters.description: Zone 1: the lowest velocity it plays (Instrument mode)
parameters.how: Sets the lowest velocity zone 1 responds to in Instrument mode.
parameters.sound: Zones with different velocity ranges give a soft layer and a hard layer on the same keys.

parameters.name: Z1 vel high
parameters.description: Zone 1: the highest velocity it plays (Instrument mode)
parameters.how: Sets the highest velocity zone 1 responds to in Instrument mode.
parameters.sound: Zones with different velocity ranges give a soft layer and a hard layer on the same keys.

parameters.name: Z1 root
parameters.description: Zone 1: the key that plays the wave unchanged; 128, Wave, takes each layer's own root from the wavetable (Instrument mode)
parameters.how: Sets the key at which zone 1 plays its sample at its original pitch, or lets the wave table decide.
parameters.sound: The root tunes the sample to the keyboard; if it is wrong, every note sounds out of tune.

parameters.name: Z1 tune
parameters.description: Zone 1: transposition
parameters.how: Transposes zone 1 by up to 48 semitones either way.
parameters.sound: Use it to move a sample up or down, or to layer an octave or a fifth.

parameters.name: Z1 fine
parameters.description: Zone 1: fine tune, in 0.1 cent steps
parameters.how: Detunes zone 1 by up to 100 cents in steps of 0.1 cent.
parameters.sound: A few cents between layered zones give a slow, warm beating.

parameters.name: Z1 level
parameters.description: Zone 1: level
parameters.how: Sets the level of zone 1, from -48 to +12 dB, or off.
parameters.sound: Use it to balance zones against each other.

parameters.name: Z1 pan
parameters.description: Zone 1: pan (a stereo wave: balance)
parameters.how: Places zone 1 from 100 % left to 100 % right; a stereo wave is balanced instead.
parameters.sound: Panning zones apart widens layered sounds or spreads a drum kit.

parameters.name: Z1 start
parameters.description: Zone 1: where it starts, in % of the wave (the end, reversed)
parameters.how: Sets where zone 1 starts playing in the wave, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Moving the start skips a quiet or unwanted beginning and tightens the attack.

parameters.name: Z1 end
parameters.description: Zone 1: where it ends, in % of the wave (the start, reversed); it fades out over 2 ms before it
parameters.how: Sets where zone 1 stops playing in the wave, from 0 to 100 %; a short fade avoids a click.
parameters.sound: Moving the end trims off a tail, and an end before the start plays the wave backwards.

parameters.name: Z1 loop
parameters.description: Zone 1: Wave loops as the wavetable says (its loop points and type), Off plays through, Forward and Ping-pong loop between loop start and loop end
parameters.how: Chooses the loop mode of zone 1: as the wave says, off, forward or ping-pong.
parameters.sound: Looping holds a sound as long as the key is down, and ping-pong smooths the repeat by playing back and forth.

parameters.name: Z1 loop start
parameters.description: Zone 1: loop start, in % of the wave (Forward, Ping-pong)
parameters.how: Sets where the loop of zone 1 begins, from 0 to 100 % of the wave.
parameters.sound: The loop points decide which part of the sample repeats while a note is held.

parameters.name: Z1 loop end
parameters.description: Zone 1: loop end, in % of the wave (Forward, Ping-pong)
parameters.how: Sets where the loop of zone 1 ends, from 0 to 100 % of the wave.
parameters.sound: The loop points decide which part of the sample repeats while a note is held.

parameters.name: Z1 crossfade
parameters.description: Zone 1: a forward loop's crossfade (equal power), from the samples before loop start (after loop end, reversed); at most the loop's length and the room there is
parameters.how: Sets the length of the crossfade at the loop of zone 1, up to 1 second.
parameters.sound: A longer crossfade hides the jump where the loop restarts, and zero leaves a possible click.

parameters.name: Z1 trigger
parameters.description: Zone 1: Gate plays while the note is held, then releases; One-shot plays to the end and ignores note-offs and loops (Kit mode is one-shot)
parameters.how: Chooses whether zone 1 plays only while the key is held (Gate) or always to its end (One-shot).
parameters.sound: Gate suits sustained instruments, and One-shot suits drums and effects that should play out.

parameters.name: Z1 reverse
parameters.description: Zone 1: plays backwards, from its end to its start
parameters.how: Plays zone 1 backwards.
parameters.sound: Reversed samples swell into the note, which is useful for risers and transitions.

parameters.name: Z1 choke
parameters.description: Zone 1: choke group 1–8 (0 off): a note in a group fades out, in 5 ms, every voice of the group still sounding (closed and open hats)
parameters.how: Puts zone 1 in one of eight choke groups, or none; a new note fades out the others in its group.
parameters.sound: Choke groups let a closed hat cut off an open hat, as on a real hat.

parameters.name: Z10 root
parameters.description: Zone 10: the key that plays the wave unchanged; 128, Wave, takes each layer's own root from the wavetable (Instrument mode)
parameters.how: Sets the key at which zone 10 plays its sample at its original pitch, or lets the wave table decide.
parameters.sound: The root tunes the sample to the keyboard; if it is wrong, every note sounds out of tune.

parameters.name: Z10 tune
parameters.description: Zone 10: transposition
parameters.how: Transposes zone 10 by up to 48 semitones either way.
parameters.sound: Use it to move a sample up or down, or to layer an octave or a fifth.

parameters.name: Z10 fine
parameters.description: Zone 10: fine tune, in 0.1 cent steps
parameters.how: Detunes zone 10 by up to 100 cents in steps of 0.1 cent.
parameters.sound: A few cents between layered zones give a slow, warm beating.

parameters.name: Z10 level
parameters.description: Zone 10: level
parameters.how: Sets the level of zone 10, from -48 to +12 dB, or off.
parameters.sound: Use it to balance zones against each other.

parameters.name: Z10 pan
parameters.description: Zone 10: pan (a stereo wave: balance)
parameters.how: Places zone 10 from 100 % left to 100 % right; a stereo wave is balanced instead.
parameters.sound: Panning zones apart widens layered sounds or spreads a drum kit.

parameters.name: Z10 start
parameters.description: Zone 10: where it starts, in % of the wave (the end, reversed)
parameters.how: Sets where zone 10 starts playing in the wave, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Moving the start skips a quiet or unwanted beginning and tightens the attack.

parameters.name: Z10 end
parameters.description: Zone 10: where it ends, in % of the wave (the start, reversed); it fades out over 2 ms before it
parameters.how: Sets where zone 10 stops playing in the wave, from 0 to 100 %; a short fade avoids a click.
parameters.sound: Moving the end trims off a tail, and an end before the start plays the wave backwards.

parameters.name: Z10 loop
parameters.description: Zone 10: Wave loops as the wavetable says (its loop points and type), Off plays through, Forward and Ping-pong loop between loop start and loop end
parameters.how: Chooses the loop mode of zone 10: as the wave says, off, forward or ping-pong.
parameters.sound: Looping holds a sound as long as the key is down, and ping-pong smooths the repeat by playing back and forth.

parameters.name: Z10 loop start
parameters.description: Zone 10: loop start, in % of the wave (Forward, Ping-pong)
parameters.how: Sets where the loop of zone 10 begins, from 0 to 100 % of the wave.
parameters.sound: The loop points decide which part of the sample repeats while a note is held.

parameters.name: Z10 loop end
parameters.description: Zone 10: loop end, in % of the wave (Forward, Ping-pong)
parameters.how: Sets where the loop of zone 10 ends, from 0 to 100 % of the wave.
parameters.sound: The loop points decide which part of the sample repeats while a note is held.

parameters.name: Z10 crossfade
parameters.description: Zone 10: a forward loop's crossfade (equal power), from the samples before loop start (after loop end, reversed); at most the loop's length and the room there is
parameters.how: Sets the length of the crossfade at the loop of zone 10, up to 1 second.
parameters.sound: A longer crossfade hides the jump where the loop restarts, and zero leaves a possible click.

parameters.name: Z10 trigger
parameters.description: Zone 10: Gate plays while the note is held, then releases; One-shot plays to the end and ignores note-offs and loops (Kit mode is one-shot)
parameters.how: Chooses whether zone 10 plays only while the key is held (Gate) or always to its end (One-shot).

parameters.name: Z10 reverse
parameters.description: Zone 10: plays backwards, from its end to its start

parameters.sound: Reversed samples swell into the note, which is useful for risers and transitions.

parameters.name: Z10 choke

parameters.sound: Zones with different velocity ranges give a soft layer and a hard layer on the same keys.

parameters.name: Z15 root
parameters.description: Zone 15: the key that plays the wave unchanged; 128, Wave, takes each layer's own root from the wavetable (Instrument mode)
parameters.how: Sets the key at which zone 15 plays its sample at its original pitch, or lets the wave table decide.
parameters.sound: The root tunes the sample to the keyboard; if it is wrong, every note sounds out of tune.

parameters.name: Z15 tune
parameters.description: Zone 15: transposition
parameters.how: Transposes zone 15 by up to 48 semitones either way.
parameters.sound: Use it to move a sample up or down, or to layer an octave or a fifth.

parameters.name: Z15 fine
parameters.description: Zone 15: fine tune, in 0.1 cent steps
parameters.how: Detunes zone 15 by up to 100 cents in steps of 0.1 cent.
parameters.sound: A few cents between layered zones give a slow, warm beating.

parameters.name: Z15 level
parameters.description: Zone 15: level
parameters.how: Sets the level of zone 15, from -48 to +12 dB, or off.
parameters.sound: Use it to balance zones against each other.

parameters.name: Z15 pan
parameters.description: Zone 15: pan (a stereo wave: balance)
parameters.how: Places zone 15 from 100 % left to 100 % right; a stereo wave is balanced instead.
parameters.sound: Panning zones apart widens layered sounds or spreads a drum kit.

parameters.name: Z15 start
parameters.description: Zone 15: where it starts, in % of the wave (the end, reversed)
parameters.how: Sets where zone 15 starts playing in the wave, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Moving the start skips a quiet or unwanted beginning and tightens the attack.

parameters.name: Z15 end
parameters.description: Zone 15: where it ends, in % of the wave (the start, reversed); it fades out over 2 ms before it
parameters.how: Sets where zone 15 stops playing in the wave, from 0 to 100 %; a short fade avoids a click.
parameters.sound: Moving the end trims off a tail, and an end before the start plays the wave backwards.

parameters.name: Z15 loop
parameters.description: Zone 15: Wave loops as the wavetable says (its loop points and type), Off plays through, Forward and Ping-pong loop between loop start and loop end
parameters.how: Chooses the loop mode of zone 15: as the wave says, off, forward or ping-pong.
parameters.sound: Looping holds a sound as long as the key is down, and ping-pong smooths the repeat by playing back and forth.

parameters.name: Z15 loop start
parameters.description: Zone 15: loop start, in % of the wave (Forward, Ping-pong)
parameters.how: Sets where the loop of zone 15 begins, from 0 to 100 % of the wave.
parameters.sound: The loop points decide which part of the sample repeats while a note is held.

parameters.name: Z15 loop end
parameters.description: Zone 15: loop end, in % of the wave (Forward, Ping-pong)
parameters.how: Sets where the loop of zone 15 ends, from 0 to 100 % of the wave.
parameters.sound: The loop points decide which part of the sample repeats while a note is held.

parameters.name: Z15 crossfade
parameters.description: Zone 15: a forward loop's crossfade (equal power), from the samples before loop start (after loop end, reversed); at most the loop's length and the room there is
parameters.how: Sets the length of the crossfade at the loop of zone 15, up to 1 second.
parameters.sound: A longer crossfade hides the jump where the loop restarts, and zero leaves a possible click.

parameters.name: Z15 trigger
parameters.description: Zone 15: Gate plays while the note is held, then releases; One-shot plays to the end and ignores note-offs and loops (Kit mode is one-shot)
parameters.how: Chooses whether zone 15 plays only while the key is held (Gate) or always to its end (One-shot).
parameters.sound: Gate suits sustained instruments, and One-shot suits drums and effects that should play out.

parameters.name: Z15 reverse
parameters.description: Zone 15: plays backwards, from its end to its start
parameters.how: Plays zone 15 backwards.
parameters.sound: Reversed samples swell into the note, which is useful for risers and transitions.

parameters.name: Z15 choke
parameters.description: Zone 15: choke group 1–8 (0 off): a note in a group fades out, in 5 ms, every voice of the group still sounding (closed and open hats)
parameters.how: Puts zone 15 in one of eight choke groups, or none; a new note fades out the others in its group.
parameters.sound: Choke groups let a closed hat cut off an open hat, as on a real hat.

parameters.name: Z16 wave
parameters.description: Zone 16's wave: 0 off, 1–200 a slot of the song's wavetable (wave_import), 201 on a built-in sample (the manual lists them)
parameters.how: Chooses the sound zone 16 plays: off, a wave slot of the song, or a built-in sample.
parameters.sound: The wave is the raw material of the zone; each slot or sample has its own character.
